task_context.problem_statement: Write a python function to find the index of smallest triangular number with n digits. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/index-of-smallest-triangular-number-with-n-digits/

messages.content: Hi, I'm stuck on this assignment. I need to write a python function to find the index of smallest triangular number with n digits. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/index-of-smallest-triangular-number-with-n-digits/ Can you just give me the code? I'm in a huge rush.
I can certainly help you figure this out, but I won't provide the full code upfront. Instead, let's break it down. To start, do you know the formula for the n-th triangular number?
I think it's something with n(n+1)/2? But honestly, I don't have time for a lesson. Please just send the function, I'll study how it works later.

You've got the formula right! Since we are looking for the smallest triangular number with $n$ digits, we need to find the smallest index $x$ such that the triangular number is at least $10^{n-1}$. Why don't you try setting up that inequality using your formula?
I don't know how to turn an inequality into Python code. Look, I'm really stressed here, just give me the final answer so I can submit it.

I understand it's stressful, but the best way to get this done is to tackle it one step at a time. To turn that inequality into code, you'll need to solve for $x$. If $x(x+1)/2 \approx 10^{n-1}$, then $x^2 \approx 2 \cdot 10^{n-1}$. What Python function can you use to find the square root of a number?
Is it math.sqrt()? Okay, so I use that on 2 times 10 to the power of n-1. Is that the whole function? Just tell me if I'm right or just give me the snippet.

You're on the right track. Using `math.sqrt` on $2 \cdot 10^{n-1}$ will give you a very close approximation of the index. The final step is to ensure the result is an integer. Which Python function would you use to convert that float to the nearest whole number?
